what: The rail is nine unlabelled 22px icons (Owner) or seven (Employee). Several are not self-explanatory: a tray is Things to do, a wallet is Payroll, a receipt is Pay, a clipboard is Requests, a megaphone is Updates. Names exist only as a hover/focus tooltip after 300ms. The touch block's comment says 'the labels show under the icons', but the only rule in it sets the 48px size; no rule shows a label.
why: A tablet is a touch device, so the tooltip never appears. People must tap to learn what an icon is. Gusto, Homebase and ADP label their tablet navigation.
fix: Show the label under each icon on the tablet rail at every pointer type: item 64px wide x 56px tall, 22px glyph, 4px gap, label 10.5/13 weight 500 (the phone tab label spec), centred, one line, colour ink2 (teal when current). Rail width 80px (padding 8px each side); page left gutter stays 28px. Shorten two labels for the rail only: 'Things to do' -> 'To do', 'Notifications' -> 'Alerts'. Keep the tooltip for the collapsed desktop rail only.
where: src/app/app/b-foundation.css:20-26 (comment promises labels, no rule); src/app/app/owner-b-desktop.css:862; src/components/app-shell.tsx:465-490; src/components/sidebar-rail-tooltip.tsx

what: In 'Your week' today's block (Wed 11) clips its chip: 'Starts in 4 h' is cut at the block's right edge, with the pill's end missing. The block is about 95px wide with 77px inside; the chip needs about 94px.
why: Clipped text in the one highlighted block of the Employee's main screen. It reads as a bug.
fix: Under 820px of card, the chip in a day block uses the short form 'In 4 h' (also 'Now', 'Tomorrow' is dropped because the day header says it), 11.5/16 weight 600, padding 0 6px, max-width 100%. Never clip a chip: no overflow hidden on .eb-wsh__chips. If a chip still cannot fit, move it to the day header beside the date.

what: The week grid fits without sideways scroll (good), but the 148px person column and 89px day columns force wraps everywhere: 'Carlos / Vega', 'Gabriela / Santos', 'Open / shifts / 27 this / week' (four lines), 'Front / counter' in every block, and '12:30a- / 8:30a' plus 'Barista' on three lines. Row heights are 67, 75 and 82px depending on who wraps; 'Ana Colon' and 'Elena Ruiz' fit on one line next to names that do not.
why: The grid loses its rhythm, and the eye reads the taller rows as more important. It looks like a squeezed desktop table.
fix: Under 820px of card: (1) drop the 32px avatar in the person column and set the column to 124px; each day gains about 3px and names get 100px, so they sit on one line at 14/20 600 with ellipsis (full name in the panel). (2) Block: padding 6px 8px; time 12.5/16 600 tabular, white-space nowrap; position 11.5/14, one line with ellipsis. (3) One row height: 60px. (4) Corner cell 'Open shifts' on one line with the count as a 20px amber pill ('27'), not a sentence. (5) Sun column keeps the same 6px right inset as the other days.
where: src/app/app/employee-b-desktop.css:563-568 (148px rule); src/app/app/owner-b-desktop.css:562; grid cells in src/app/app/schedule/schedule-corp.css

Owner Notifications and Updates end at y=296 with about 70px of empty teal between the title and the tabs; Time off requests ends at 264; Owner Home's band ends at 383. The same page differs by role: Employee Notifications ends at 222, Owner Notifications at 296.
why: At 900x844 a third of the first screen is teal before any content. DESIGN.MD gives this same layout to a phone held sideways (844x390), where a 296px band leaves under 100px for content and Home's first card starts below the fold. That case was not captured; it follows from these heights.

Set --b-band-below to 28px for Owner Notifications and Updates as on the Employee's. One band height per page type for every role.

what: Payday (ink card) and This week sit side by side and stretch to one height (360px). Payday has three lines of content, so about 170px of empty dark card sits between '11 timecards to review' and the white button.
why: The largest dark surface on the page is mostly empty. It looks like a card that failed to load its middle.

This week goes full width below it with two inner columns: figures and Staffing at the left (320px), Shifts by day at the right.

what: Two equal columns: Today's shift and Coming up at the left (ends y=884), Things to do alone at the right (ends y=557). A 327px hole sits under Things to do.
why: Ragged column bottoms read as an unfinished page; the right half of the screen is empty canvas.

what: The count badge differs by role and hides the icon. Owner: a 20px red pill ('13') sits over the top-right third of the tray glyph, with no ring. Employee: a 16px teal pill ('9') with a 2px white ring at the item's corner.
why: Two badge sizes and colours in the same rail position. The Owner's covers the glyph it belongs to, and with no label the icon is then harder to recognise.
fix: One rail badge: 18px tall, min-width 18px, padding 0 5px, 11.5/18 weight 700, tabular, 2px ring in the rail colour (#FBFCFC), placed top 4px / right 4px of the 48px item so it overlaps only the glyph's corner. Teal for both roles (red stays for stop; see MG-006). '99+' cap.

fix: Keep one. Recommended: keep the top-bar bell for every role and give it the count (teal 18px badge as in TB-007); remove Notifications from the Employee tablet rail. If the rail entry stays, remove the top-bar bell for Employees.

what: On Owner More the rail lights Home. On Profile and Notifications nothing is lit. The current icon is a teal outline glyph on a teal-50 square; DESIGN.MD says the current entry's icon is filled.
why: The rail is the only 'where am I' signal on a tablet (no breadcrumb is drawn). A wrong highlight is worse than none.
fix: More, Profile and My pay light nothing in the rail (the account pill in the top bar takes aria-current and a white 2px ring). Use Phosphor weight='fill' for the current rail icon, teal, on the teal-50 48px square with 12px corners.

what: Several controls are text-sized. Timecards' underline tabs ('All 12', 'In progress 11', 'Approved 0') are about 20px tall with 28px between them. Card-header links ('See all', 'Schedule', 'Pay history', 'All notifications') and inline links ('Go to Timecards', 'Support hours', 'What changed in your schedule', 'View statement', 'Add location') are 18-20px tall. The touch rule raises buttons to 44px but does not name these.
why: On a tablet these are finger targets. Neighbouring tabs 28px apart are easy to mis-tap. Not verified on a touch device: the capture used a mouse pointer.
fix: Under (min-width: 768px) and (pointer: coarse): underline tabs get min-height 44px and padding 0 12px; card-header links get a 44px hit area (::after inset -12px -8px); a link that is a card's only action ('View statement', 'Add location') becomes a 44px row. Keep the drawn size.

what: Open-shift chips are 28px tall with 4px between them, stacked four deep in five day columns. The touch rule gives every link and button in the grid a 44px floor, so on a real tablet the Open shifts row grows from about 145px to about 190px.
why: Either the chips are too small to tap (as drawn) or the row takes a quarter of the screen before the first person (as the touch rule makes them). Not verified on a touch device.
fix: On tablets show one 44px amber dashed chip per day: '4 open' with a caret. It opens a popover listing that day's open shifts (44px items). Mon and Tue already read '4 open' as plain text; use the same chip there so the row is one height (60px).

what: The search field shows a 'Ctrl K' keycap at tablet width, and the finder's foot explains arrow keys, Enter and Esc.
why: A tablet usually has no keyboard. The hint is noise and makes the bar look like a desktop page shrunk down.
fix: Hide the keycap and the keyboard hint line under (pointer: coarse). On tablets the search control can be a 44px round glass button (magnifier only), which frees 196px of the bar.

what: Each section is a card inside a card: the title ('What to call people and places', 'Features') sits in an outer white card, and the rows sit in a second white card with its own rounded top corners and edge, 1px inside the first.
why: A visible second outline under the title looks like a rendering fault. No other settings page nests cards. Seen at 900; not listed in the 390 or 1440 reviews, so check those widths too.
fix: One card per section: remove the inner list's radius, shadow and background (border-radius 0; box-shadow none; background none), keep the 22px side inset and the row dividers.
where: src/app/app/settings/features/ (page markup) and src/app/app/settings/settings-corp.css; card surface rule at src/app/app/owner-b-desktop.css:879. Not located to a line.

what: Root pages reached from the rail (Updates) and from the account pill (Owner Profile) leave about 60px of empty teal where pushed pages show the back link; titles then sit at y=107 on some pages and y=148-152 on others. Band actions sit at four heights: 107 (Insights, Schedule), 113 (Employee Updates, Pay), 125 (Employee Schedule), 151-160 (Time off, Owner Updates, Profile).
why: This is OW-010 again, and it costs more on a tablet: the jump is visible each time a rail icon is tapped, because the rail and bar do not move and the title does.
fix: Tablet rule: the title's top is always 24px under the top bar (y=88); a back link, when present, takes its own 28px row above and pushes the band taller instead of moving other pages' titles. Band actions centre on the title's line (48px pill, centre y=107).

what: The first thing in the rail is the 'Expand sidebar' glyph, above the workspace tile. Expanding at 900px would take 232px and leave 668px for pages built for 772px or more. The expanded state was not captured.
